speaker: Harrok the Unbowed
description: P34 (plan M6-M9 section 2.10, 5.13): Harrok's yield in the honour duel - the yield protocol's two-choice prompt. Spare (outcome spare: the duel is won) or Strike, which asks again before it counts (outcome strike: he rises and fights to the death); the confirm line offers 'No - let me think again' first (M8 gate F7: Strike is never the first choice nor the default).

nodes.text: Harrok drops to one knee and lays his axe on the stone. "The duel is yours. The clans have seen it. Will you take my life as well?"

choices.text: Spare him. The duel is won.

nodes.text: The watching clans fall silent. Strike a giant who knelt to you? He will rise and fight to the death.

choices.text: Strike. (There is no taking it back.)

nodes.text: Harrok rises and bows his head. "The Moot will hear that the Unbowed bowed - and was spared."
Harrok's eyes harden. He takes up his axe and rises: this ends with one of you dead.
